worldcombat.skill.sludge.summary: The user scoops up a wet clump of sludge and hurls it at the foe on a low arc: cheap, quick and PP-rich; a hit that deals damage may poison the target while the clump clings and drips. Cling style is stickier, bigger and more likely to poison, at the cost of damage and speed.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.0: Chip a distant foe and keep it poisoned
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.1: Always have a cheap shot ready
worldcombat.skill.sludge.use.2: Make the foe step out of the arc
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.0: A hit smears the clump for about %1$s damage and lets it drip; the target's Sp. Def, type and crit normally affect this hit.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.1: It is thrown up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, and the arc shows where it will land.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.description.2: After a hit that deals damage, the target has a %1$s poison chance; the poison drains health over time and lasts %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.cling.on: Cling style on: a bigger, stickier glob and ×1.3 poison chance, at ×0.9 damage, a slower throw and one extra beat of wind-up. Poison duration is unaffected by cling.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.cling.off: Cling style off (Quick throw): ×1.1 damage, a faster throw and a quicker recovery, but a smaller chance to stick.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown starting on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.growth.0: At level %1$s the wet clump rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.growth.1: At level %1$s the wet clump rises to %2$s power and the poison chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.clin: On: a bigger, stickier glob and ×1.3 poison chance, at ×0.9 damage, a slower throw and one extra beat of wind-up, for grinding a foe down. Off (Quick throw): a faster, heavier throw at ×1.1 damage with less chance to stick. Poison duration is unaffected by cling.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.m: Only foes within this distance become throwing candidates; the companion then walks into throw range. Higher starts the chase earlier.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.s: On, an already poisoned foe is not a candidate: another clump only refreshes the poison, so another target is better. Off throws at poisoned foes too.
worldcombat.skill.sludge.preference.ai.l: On, the companion may leave its post to throw at a target; off restricts it to throws it can make from where it stands.
